style: Photorealistic industrial photograph, crisp sharp focus, cool white factory lighting, square composition. No readable text, no letters or numbers, no brand names, no logos anywhere.

items.prompt: A bright, clean, modern smart factory seen from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. On the left, a large white and dark-gray five-axis CNC machining center with its glass door showing a metal spindle and fixture inside. In the center, a white six-axis industrial robot arm lifts a freshly machined shiny aluminum part from a tray. In front, a roller conveyor carries blue trays filled with neat rows of precision-machined cylindrical metal parts. Behind, more CNC machines and an automated production line recede into the distance, with a wall monitor showing a green status screen. Polished gray epoxy floor with yellow safety lines.

A modern automated machining line in a spotless factory: a white five-axis CNC machining center on the left with an illuminated glass door, a white robot arm in the middle loading a gleaming machined metal part, and in the foreground a conveyor with blue trays holding dozens of finished precision metal parts in tidy rows. Additional CNC machines, signal tower lights and a small autonomous cart in the background. Gray floor with yellow lane markings, cool daylight from high windows.
